content.shloka:
Om Namaśchaṇḍikāyai
Om Aiṁ Hrīṁ Klīṁ Chāmuṇḍāyai Vichche
content.meaning: Salutations to Goddess Chandika. Om Aim Hrim Klim — I invoke Chamunda, the slayer of demons.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Namaścaṇḍikāyai
Oṁ Aiṁ Hrīṁ Klīṁ Cāmuṇḍāyai Vicce

content.shloka:
Mahākālī Mahālakṣmī Mahāsarasvatī rūpiṇyai
Navārṇa Mantra Svarūpiṇyai Namaḥ
content.meaning: Salutations to the Goddess who manifests as Mahakali, Mahalakshmi, and Mahasarasvati, who is the embodiment of the Navarna Mantra.
content.transliteration:
Mahākālī Mahālakṣmī Mahāsarasvatī Rūpiṇyai
Navārṇa Mantra Svarūpiṇyai Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Viṣṇuḥ Yoganidrāṁ Yadi Jagadvyāpinīṁ
Madhu Kaiṭabha Nāśanārthaṁ Devī Stutiṁ Cakruḥ
content.meaning: When Lord Vishnu was in Yoganidra (cosmic sleep), the Devas prayed to the all-pervading Goddess for the destruction of the demons Madhu and Kaitabha.
content.transliteration:
Viṣṇuḥ Yoganidrāṁ Yadi Jagadvyāpinīṁ
Madhu Kaiṭabha Nāśanārthaṁ Devī Stutiṁ Cakruḥ

content.shloka:
Yā Devī Sarvabhūteṣu Nidrā Rūpeṇa Saṁsthitā
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namaḥ
content.meaning: To that Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of sleep — salutations to Her, salutations to Her, salutations to Her again and again.
content.transliteration:
Yā Devī Sarvabhūteṣu Nidrā Rūpeṇa Saṁsthitā
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Brahmā Uvāca:
Tathaiva Cā Kṛṣya Jagatkṛtau
Madhu Kaiṭabhau Durātmānau Hantumicchati Vai Hariḥ
content.meaning: Brahma said: Thus, Lord Hari desired to slay the evil-souled Madhu and Kaitabha for the creation and protection of the universe.
content.transliteration:
Brahmā Uvāca:
Tathaiva Cā Kṛṣya Jagatkṛtau
Madhu Kaiṭabhau Durātmānau Hantumicchati Vai Hariḥ

content.shloka:
Mahiṣāsura Senānīnāṁ Tathā Sainyasya Sarvaśaḥ
Vadhaṁ Prāha Mahādevyā Devānāmapi Cāmaraṁ
content.meaning: The great Goddess slew the generals of Mahishasura's army and the entire host, granting fearlessness to the Devas.
content.transliteration:
Mahiṣāsura Senānīnāṁ Tathā Sainyasya Sarvaśaḥ
Vadhaṁ Prāha Mahādevyā Devānāmapi Cāmaraṁ

content.shloka:
Tejaḥ Samasta Devānāṁ Ekaṁ Rūpam Avardhata
Tadā Prādurabhūd Devī Trailokyaṁ Teja Āvṛtam
content.meaning: The combined radiance of all the gods converged into one form, and the Goddess manifested, filling the three worlds with Her splendor.
content.transliteration:
Tejaḥ Samasta Devānāṁ Ekaṁ Rūpam Avardhata
Tadā Prādurabhūd Devī Trailokyaṁ Teja Āvṛtam

content.shloka:
Siṁhaṁ Samāruhya Mahāsuraṁ Tam
Mahiṣaṁ Chittvaiva Khaḍgena Durgā
Lokānāṁ Rakṣaṇārthaṁ Jagadambā
content.meaning: Mounting the lion, Durga, the Mother of the universe, slew the great demon Mahishasura with Her sword for the protection of all worlds.
content.transliteration:
Siṁhaṁ Samāruhya Mahāsuraṁ Tam
Mahiṣaṁ Chittvaiva Khaḍgena Durgā
Lokānāṁ Rakṣaṇārthaṁ Jagadambā

content.shloka:
Sarvamangala Māṅgalye Śive Sarvārtha Sādhike
Śaraṇye Tryambake Gauri Nārāyaṇi Namostute
content.meaning: O auspicious of all that is auspicious, O consort of Shiva, O fulfiller of all objectives, O refuge, O three-eyed Gauri, O Narayani, salutations to You.
content.transliteration:
Sarvamāṅgala Māṅgalye Śive Sarvārtha Sādhike
Śaraṇye Tryambake Gauri Nārāyaṇi Namostute

content.shloka:
Jayā Jayā Śrī Mahiṣāsura Mardinī
Ramyā Kapardini Śailasute Namaḥ
content.meaning: Victory, victory to the slayer of Mahishasura! Salutations to the beautiful one with matted locks, daughter of the mountain.
content.transliteration:
Jayā Jayā Śrī Mahiṣāsura Mardinī
Ramyā Kapardini Śailasute Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Śumbha Niśumbha Sainyānāṁ Nāśāya Paramātmikā
Kālī Tārā Mahāvidyā Ṣoḍaśī Bhuvaneśvarī
content.meaning: For the destruction of the armies of Shumbha and Nishumbha, the Supreme Goddess manifested as Kali, Tara, Mahavidya, Shodashi, and Bhuvaneshvari.
content.transliteration:
Śumbha Niśumbha Sainyānāṁ Nāśāya Paramātmikā
Kālī Tārā Mahāvidyā Ṣoḍaśī Bhuvaneśvarī

content.shloka:
Raktabījaṁ Mahāghōraṁ Chāmuṇḍā Pītvā Rudhiraṁ
Jaghāna Sarvaloke Vai Mahiṣāsura Saṁhṛtiḥ
content.meaning: The fierce Chamunda drank the blood of the terrible Raktabija and slew him, completing the destruction that began with Mahishasura.
content.transliteration:
Raktabījaṁ Mahāghōraṁ Cāmuṇḍā Pītvā Rudhiraṁ
Jaghāna Sarvaloke Vai Mahiṣāsura Saṁhṛtiḥ

content.shloka:
Niśumbhaṁ Nihataṁ Dṛṣṭvā Bhrātaraṁ Prāṇasammitam
Śumbhaḥ Kruddhō Abravīd Vākyaṁ Durgāṁ Prati
content.meaning: Seeing his brother Nishumbha slain, Shumbha, enraged, spoke words of challenge to Goddess Durga.
content.transliteration:
Niśumbhaṁ Nihataṁ Dṛṣṭvā Bhrātaraṁ Prāṇasammitam
Śumbhaḥ Kruddhō Abravīd Vākyaṁ Durgāṁ Prati

content.shloka:
Devī Uvāca: Ekaivaham Jagat Atra Dvitīyā Kā Mamāparā
Paśyaitā Dushṭa Mayyeva Viśantyo Madvibhūtayaḥ
content.meaning: The Goddess said: I alone exist in this universe. Who is there besides Me? Behold, O wicked one, these are but My own powers entering back into Me.
content.transliteration:
Devī Uvāca: Ekaivaham Jagat Atra Dvitīyā Kā Mamāparā
Paśyaitā Duṣṭa Mayyeva Viśantyo Madvibhūtayaḥ

content.shloka:
Itthaṁ Yadā Yadā Bādhā Dānavōtthā Bhaviṣyati
Tadā Tadā Avatīrya Ahaṁ Kariṣyāmi Arināśanam
content.meaning: Whenever there arises affliction caused by demons, I shall incarnate and bring about the destruction of those enemies.
content.transliteration:
Itthaṁ Yadā Yadā Bādhā Dānavōtthā Bhaviṣyati
Tadā Tadā Avatīrya Ahaṁ Kariṣyāmi Arināśanam

content.shloka:
Om Namaśchaṇḍikāyai
Mārkāṇḍeya Uvāca:
Om Yad Guhyaṁ Paramaṁ Loke Sarvārakṣākaram Nṛṇām
Yanna Kasya Cidākhyātaṁ Tanme Brūhi Pitāmaha
content.meaning: Markandeya said: O Grandfather (Brahma), please tell me the supreme secret of this world, the protective shield for all beings, that which has not been revealed to anyone.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Namaścaṇḍikāyai
Mārkāṇḍeya Uvāca:
Oṁ Yad Guhyaṁ Paramaṁ Loke Sarvārakṣākaraṁ Nṛṇām
Yanna Kasya Cidākhyātaṁ Tanme Brūhi Pitāmaha

content.shloka:
Śailaputryā Rājaṁ Śiro Me Pātu Sarvadā
Brahmachāriṇī Pātu Lalāṭaṁ Chandraghaṇṭā Kuṭilaṁ
content.meaning: May Shailaputri always protect my head. May Brahmacharini protect my forehead. May Chandraghanta protect my crown.
content.transliteration:
Śailaputryā Rājaṁ Śiro Me Pātu Sarvadā
Brahmacāriṇī Pātu Lalāṭaṁ Candraghaṇṭā Kuṭilaṁ

content.shloka:
Pādau Me Pātu Kālī Hrīṁ Pātu Pādayor Aṅguliḥ
Nakhān Pātu Mahālakṣmī Sarvāṅgaṁ Sarvadā'vatu
content.meaning: May Kali protect my feet. May Hrim protect my toes. May Mahalakshmi protect my nails. May She always protect my entire body.
content.transliteration:
Pādau Me Pātu Kālī Hrīṁ Pātu Pādayor Aṅguliḥ
Nakhān Pātu Mahālakṣmī Sarvāṅgaṁ Sarvadā'vatu

content.shloka:
Sarvamaṅgala Māṅgalye Devī Kavachaṁ Yaḥ Paṭhet
Sa Sarvāriṣṭa Vinirmukto Dhanadhānya Sutānvitaḥ
content.meaning: Whoever recites this Devi Kavacham, bestower of all auspiciousness, is freed from all calamities and blessed with wealth, grain, and progeny.
content.transliteration:
Sarvamaṅgala Māṅgalye Devī Kavacaṁ Yaḥ Paṭhet
Sa Sarvāriṣṭa Vinirmukto Dhanadhānya Sutānvitaḥ

content.shloka:
Om Jayantī Maṅgalā Kālī Bhadrakālī Kapālinī
Durgā Kṣamā Śivā Dhātrī Svāhā Svadhā Namo'stute
content.meaning: Om! Salutations to Jayanti, Mangala, Kali, Bhadrakali, Kapalini, Durga, Kshama, Shiva, Dhatri, Svaha, and Svadha.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Jayantī Maṅgalā Kālī Bhadrakālī Kapālinī
Durgā Kṣamā Śivā Dhātrī Svāhā Svadhā Namo'stute

content.shloka:
Jayā Tvam Devi Chāmuṇḍe Jayā Bhūtāpahāriṇi
Jayā Sarvagate Devi Kālarātri Namo'stute
content.meaning: Victory to You, O Goddess Chamunda! Victory to You, remover of evil spirits! Victory to You, O all-pervading Goddess Kalaratri, salutations to You.
content.transliteration:
Jayā Tvam Devi Cāmuṇḍe Jayā Bhūtāpahāriṇi
Jayā Sarvagate Devi Kālarātri Namo'stute

content.shloka:
Rūpaṁ Dehi Jayaṁ Dehi Yaśo Dehi Dviṣo Jahi
Mahiṣāsura Nāśinyai Namaḥ
content.meaning: Grant me beauty, grant me victory, grant me fame, and destroy my enemies. Salutations to the slayer of Mahishasura.
content.transliteration:
Rūpaṁ Dehi Jayaṁ Dehi Yaśo Dehi Dviṣo Jahi
Mahiṣāsura Nāśinyai Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Vidhehi Devi Kalyāṇaṁ Vidhehi Paramāṁ Śriyam
Rūpaṁ Dehi Jayaṁ Dehi Yaśo Dehi Dviṣo Jahi
content.meaning: O Goddess, bestow welfare upon me, bestow supreme prosperity. Grant me beauty, grant me victory, grant me fame, and destroy my enemies.
content.transliteration:
Vidhehi Devi Kalyāṇaṁ Vidhehi Paramāṁ Śriyam
Rūpaṁ Dehi Jayaṁ Dehi Yaśo Dehi Dviṣo Jahi

content.shloka:
Patnīṁ Manoramāṁ Dehi Manovrittānusāriṇīm
Tāriṇīṁ Durgasaṁsāra Sāgarasya Kulōdbhavām
content.meaning: Grant me a beautiful and devoted spouse who follows the desires of my heart. Grant me Her who delivers us across the ocean of this difficult worldly existence.
content.transliteration:
Patnīṁ Manoramāṁ Dehi Manovrittānusāriṇīm
Tāriṇīṁ Durgasaṁsāra Sāgarasya Kulōdbhavām

content.shloka:
Om Namaśchaṇḍikāyai
Mārkāṇḍeya Uvāca:
Viśuddha Jñāna Dehāya Trivedī Divya Chakṣuṣe
Śreyaḥ Prāpti Nimittāya Namaḥ Somārdha Dhāriṇe
content.meaning: Markandeya said: Salutations to the one of pure knowledge-form, the three-eyed one with divine vision, for the attainment of supreme good, to the bearer of the crescent moon.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Namaścaṇḍikāyai
Mārkāṇḍeya Uvāca:
Viśuddha Jñāna Dehāya Trivedī Divya Cakṣuṣe
Śreyaḥ Prāpti Nimittāya Namaḥ Somārdha Dhāriṇe

content.shloka:
Om Idaṁ Stōtraṁ Mahāpuṇyaṁ Saptaśatyā Samāhitam
Kīlakēna Samāyuktaṁ Maṅgalāya Pracoditam
content.meaning: This hymn of great merit, united with the Saptashati, when joined with the Kilaka, is inspired for auspiciousness.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Idaṁ Stōtraṁ Mahāpuṇyaṁ Saptaśatyā Samāhitam
Kīlakēna Samāyuktaṁ Maṅgalāya Pracoditam

content.shloka:
Śṛṇuṣva Mama Viprarṣe Saptaśatyāḥ Idaṁ Mahat
Kīlakaṁ Yanna Jānanti Tattvaṁ Na Phalam Āpnuyuḥ
content.meaning: O sage among Brahmins, hear this great Kilaka of the Saptashati. Those who do not know its essence do not obtain its fruit.
content.transliteration:
Śṛṇuṣva Mama Viprarṣe Saptaśatyāḥ Idaṁ Mahat
Kīlakaṁ Yanna Jānanti Tattvaṁ Na Phalam Āpnuyuḥ

content.shloka:
Namo Devyai Mahādevyai Śivāyai Satataṁ Namaḥ
Namaḥ Prakṛtyai Bhadrāyai Niyatāḥ Praṇatāḥ Sma Tām
content.meaning: Salutations to the Goddess, the great Goddess. Continuous salutations to the auspicious one. Salutations to Prakriti, the benevolent one — devoted, we bow to Her.
content.transliteration:
Namo Devyai Mahādevyai Śivāyai Satataṁ Namaḥ
Namaḥ Prakṛtyai Bhadrāyai Niyatāḥ Praṇatāḥ Sma Tām
